sentences.text:
The present application under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. seeks quashing of FIR No. 304/2019,
under Section 498A/406/34 of the IPC, registered at P.S. Ranhola and all other proceedings emanating therefrom, including the chargesheet pending in the Court of competent jurisdiction.

2. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of petitioners submits that petitioner no. 1 and respondent no. 2 have entered into a Memorandum of Understanding dated 20.01.2021 and in pursuance thereof the marriage between petitioner no. 1 and respondent no. 2 has been dissolved by decree of divorce by mutual consent dated 28.08.2021.
3. Issue notice.
4. Learned APP for the State accepts notice and seeks some time to file the status report.
Let the same be filed before the next date of hearing.

5. Issue notice to respondent no. 2, through all permissible modes, including electronic mail, if any,
returnable on 13.09.2023.
This is a digitally signed order.
